rmsPathReferenceObjectId.description: Optional RMS traversal reference source slot; resolve owner-effective masters during generation. Null or absent means unavailable, not an implicit reference.

setupDependentSpawnTechnologies.description: Automatic spawn technologies whose prerequisites no RMS-time route researches from a standard start; exact generation rejects a later starting age for their civilizations.

objectResourceSlotVariants.description: Disjoint, complete civilization groups for masters whose constructor resources vary by owner table.

objectMovementSpeedVariants.description: Disjoint, complete civilization groups for masters whose raw movement speed varies by owner table.

civilizationAttributeValues.description: Numeric player attributes of each civilization at generation start, sorted by civilization then attribute.

technologyStateRules.description: Generation-start native technology states, sorted by technology.

startupTechnologyResourceEffects.description: Technologies the game completes for players before map generation whose effects change a resource the farm completion reads, with their resource rows in order; sorted by civilization, route and technology (content 2.5.0).

graphics.description: Construction-relevant standing-graphic facts, sorted by graphic id. No art or frame data.

allOf.description: Executable-owned generation bindings are required from 2.2.0; older documents cannot carry 2.2 facts.

Building construction-site facts start with 2.3.0: a 2.3.0, 2.4.0 or 2.5.0 document names the constructor exemptions and states the facts of every building master (the loader checks the constructor type); older documents cannot carry them.
Fallback player-start role identities start with 2.4.0: a 2.4.0 or 2.5.0 document names them; older documents cannot carry them.
Farm completion roles and startup technology effects are 2.5.0 facts: a 2.5.0 document names the roles; older documents cannot carry either.

civilizationId.description: Absent (2.2.0) for a technology available to every civilization.

placementRules.description: Omitted or null is unavailable; never infer family from obstruction.

placementRuleVariants.description: Disjoint complete civilization groups, alternative to uniform rules.

occupancyUsesMovementSpeed.description: Constructor-selected occupancy speed eligibility, independent of position family. Omitted/null is unavailable, not false.

pathing.description: Initialized path occupancy metadata; omitted or null is unavailable, not an empty obstruction.

class39PathingGate.description: Content half of the live class-39 pathing-gate predicate. Omitted or null is unavailable, not false.

constructionRetirementRequiresHeight.description: Protect this existing master from construction retirement unless its separately supplied vertical extent is positive. Omission declares the ordinary height-independent rule.

hitPoints.description: Signed master hit points. Omission or null is unavailable metadata, not a durable-object default.

restrictionVariants.description: Disjoint complete owner-table groups; alternative to a uniform restriction.

resourceSlots.description: Three ordered initialization slots; null denotes unavailable metadata, not empty resources.

initialResourceOverride.description: Optional constructor-selected instance resource state after ordered storage-slot initialization.

standingGraphicId.description: Primary standing graphic whose construction behavior is described by creationRng. Omission is unavailable metadata for RMS standing-graphic effects.

standingGraphicCreationVariants.description: Additional content-derived construction profiles reachable through ordered RMS primary-standing-graphic effects.

graphicReplacementVariants.description: Changed active graphics and setter facet behavior when a constructed Gaia object adopts the authored civilization master.

disappearsWhenBuilt.description: The native building is retired when construction completes; one with a stack unit (its neighbor link) is first replaced by that unit, which exact generation refuses to construct.

constructorType.description: Native constructor family that selects creation-RNG semantics for graphics an effect installs.

buildingConstruction.description: 2.3.0, building masters (constructor type 80) only: the two facts the building constructor reads to start a construction site with 1 hit point.

positiveBuildTime.description: The first train location's build time is positive; a master without a train location has none.

headUnit.description: The master names a head unit.

requiredAttributeId.description: Owners whose numeric player attribute is not positive are skipped.

technologyStateGate.description: At least one listed technology must be in the native state: -1 disabled, 0 unavailable, 1 available, 3 researched.

technologyStateRule.description: Available once at least requiredCount listed technologies are researched; disabled and automatically researched civilizations are disjoint.

nativeGenerationBindings.description: Executable-owned generation identities of one version, removing content literals from the engine.

constructionSiteExemptions.description: Masters and classes the building constructor never starts as a construction site (from content 2.3.0, native bindings 1.1.0); ascending.

placementPathingMaskI32.description: Signed runtime restriction mask used against live occupancy words. It is not derivable from terrain costs or the restriction ID.

playerStartBindings.description: Executable-owned role identities for ordinary fallback player starts; content 2.4.0/native bindings 1.2.0.

farmCompletionBindings.description: Executable-owned roles of the perimeter farm completion; content 2.5.0/native bindings 1.3.0. Parents ascend and are unique; spawned masters are an ordered, weighted list.

route.description: automatic: the civilization's own automatic technology; team: completed by the civilization's team effect for its players and their allies.
